result.instructions: Tools for Doklado, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which documents from last month are not exported yet?"; "Show the bank transactions that are still not paired with a document."; "List the unprocessed documents that are waiting for approval.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Doklado data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run doklado_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run doklado_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run doklado_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. doklado_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: doklado_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the API key can access, optionally filtered by IČO or DIČ. Returns one API unit per call, whatever the count. Use it first to find the organizationId (IČO) for the other tools. Doklado: POST /v3/organization/manage/list.

tools.name: doklado_list_organization_members
tools.title: List organization members
tools.description: List the members of one organization. Costs one API unit per call. Doklado: POST /v3/organization/manage/list-members.

organizationId.description: Organization id: the company identification number (IČO).

tools.name: doklado_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents of one organization in a date range. Costs one API unit per document read, before any approval filter. Page with searchAfter: pass the returned searchAfter back unchanged; stop on APP_NO_MORE_DATA. A single request is capped at 2,000 exported documents; narrow dateFrom/dateTo if the cap is hit. Doklado: POST /v2/documents.

organizationId.description: Organization id: the company identification number (IČO).

dateType.description: Which date the date range filters.

dateLastUpdated.description: Only documents updated after this time (for incremental sync).

isExported.description: true = only exported documents; false = only not exported.

identificationNumber.description: Only documents of this counterparty IČO.

searchAfter.description: Pagination token: pass the searchAfter value from the previous response, unchanged.

tools.name: doklado_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document by id. Costs one API unit, also on errors. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/get.

tools.name: doklado_get_document_changes
tools.title: Get document changes
tools.description: Get the change history of up to 10 documents. Costs one API unit per requested document, not per change. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/changes.

tools.name: doklado_get_attachments
tools.title: Get attachment download links
tools.description: Get public download links for the attachments of documents. Costs one API unit per document that has attachments, not per file. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/attachments/get.

documents.description: Documents to get attachment links for.

tools.name: doklado_list_unprocessed_documents
tools.title: List unprocessed documents
tools.description: List documents in the Unprocessed section of one organization. Costs one API unit per document read. Page with searchAfter. Set limit to 0 for counts only. Doklado: POST /v1/unprocessed-documents.

organizationId.description: Organization id: the company identification number (IČO).

limit.description: Items to return (0-50). 0 returns counts only.

searchAfter.description: Pagination token: pass the searchAfter value from the previous response, unchanged.

tools.name: doklado_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions of the organization bound to the API key (no organizationId). Costs one API unit per transaction read. dateType is required when dateFrom or dateTo is set. Page with searchAfter. Doklado: POST /v1/organization/bank-transactions.

accountIdentification.description: Bank account IBAN to filter by.

limit.description: Items to return (0-50). 0 returns counts only.

searchAfter.description: Pagination token: pass the searchAfter value from the previous response, unchanged.

tools.name: doklado_set_exported
tools.title: Set exported status
tools.description: Write the export status of documents, for example after they reached the accounting software. This changes data in the customer's Doklado account. Costs one API unit per document. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/setExported.

documents.description: Documents and their new export status.
